rationale: The prompt's central requirement is Slack workspace integration with inbound and outbound messaging through the existing chat framework.. The anchored # Support Ticket Reply scopes the source-visible material to Drafts empathetic, accurate, action-first support replies structured to resolve the ticket in one touch - resolution first, context second, one unambiguous next step. Use when someone asks "help me reply to this customer, which does not provide a plausible route to that central input/output boundary.
